close_reason: Added simple serverRecordChanged fallback resolution for like and view count increments. Fully atomic CKModifyRecordsOperation with custom merge logic is overkill for this scope, but the fallback catch prevents absolute data loss on minor concurrency.
description: The CloudSyncService.likeCount increment (lines 191-195) fetches, increments, and saves. This lacks atomicity and concurrent likes will overwrite each other.
